title: Workspace watcher treats any absolute ancestor named `target` as ignored, so a checkout under a `target` directory ignores every source event
outcome: Build-directory exclusion in the workspace watcher is judged relative to the workspace root, so a checkout located below a directory named `target` still reports its source file events.
acceptance: Workspace watcher treats any absolute ancestor named `target` as ignored, so a checkout under a `target` directory ignores every source event is done
